title: Bhabar region map
subject: Geography
caption: Map of the Bhabar region in Uttarakhand highlighting heavy sediment deposition from streams.
altText: A textbook‑style map on a white background showing the Bhabar region in Uttarakhand, India. The narrow Bhabar zone along the foothills is highlighted, with major streams like the Ramganga marked. Color‑coded areas indicate deposition of coarse gravels, sand, and silt. The map includes a legend, scale bar, north arrow, and labels for Bhabar, foothills, alluvial plain, and river channels, providing an accurate, high‑resolution depiction of the region's alluvial processes.
